extracted.title: Online registration open for religious organisations and student volunteers — not for general pilgrims
extracted.summary: Press coverage reports QR-code online registration for religious and charitable organisations serving devotees, and registration for student 'Kumbhdoot' volunteers. No registration or e-pass requirement for general visitors has been reported.

excerpt: Search-result summary: 84 organisations completed registration via the Authority's QR single-window system; student volunteer registrations open.
extractionNote: Drafted from a search-engine summary of the page. The article text itself was not read. An editor must open the source, check every detail, and set publishedAt before approving.
